name: Amphisbaena
source:
A Next Doll, one of the strongest Chimeric Monsters created by Promestein. Covered in unique armor and weapons, she was created to defeat Erubetie of the Four Heavenly Knights.

An ultra-vibration blade to destroy on a cellular level, vibration armor to defend against slime, a plasma field to microwave liquid around her, she is completely anti-slime in focus. Her physical ability is also extremely high, and her ultra-vibration blade seems effective against normal armor, too.

But due to all the sensitive machines, she is quite weak to shock and damage. In addition, the extreme power use of her equipment doesn't enable her to fight for a long period of time. Though lacking in versatility, she is extremely specialized in countering the seemingly-invincible Erubetie.

[From In-game Monsterpedia]
